description.value:
Effect DC 20 or lower needs no check at all; harder locks grant a +1 circumstance bonus (Novice) to the Thievery check that follows

Run a hand along any mundane lock or checkpoint scanner and know its make, its weak point, and roughly how long it'll take to beat — all in the time it takes to check a wristwatch.

cinderfall.incomplete: Downgraded from MIXED to INCOMPLETE during the citation-strength spot-check (2026-09-13): the proposed RollOption(toggleable)+FlatModifier self-bonus (toggle option 'skeleton-read') cited only this class's own internal precedent (corporate-cover.json / quick-fingers.json / underledger-rank.json, all in this same folder) -- no real pf2e-source file:line backs this specific mechanism. Checked pf2e-source for a closer match: packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-1/risky-surgery.json does ship a toggleable RollOption + predicated FlatModifier for a self-elected bonus, but always gated on a concrete, checkable action predicate (action:treat-wounds) plus a stated mechanical cost (1d8 self-damage) -- never on pure narrative/GM judgment with no checkable predicate, which is the shape this proposal used. Left unbuilt pending a stricter design call. The "DC <=20 needs no check at all" clause remains correctly un-encoded/narrative either way (matches feats/skill glad-hand.json-style procedural skips, which ship "rules": []).
